template: Given the sensor stream up to {t}ms (provided below), had {event} occurred at time {t2}ms, rank the signal segments listed in the 'options' field in the order you would expect them to appear afterward in this counterfactual scenario. Answer only with a four letter string indicating your ranking (ie. DCAB), nothing else.

answer_format.notes: Model must output a permutation of [A, B, C, D]. Chunks should be kept short to limit token cost. The correct ordering reflects causal propagation delay across signals.

template: Had {event} occurred at time {t2}ms, what would most likely happen next in this counterfactual trajectory? Answer only with a 4 letter string using F and T to indicate your answers (ie. TFFT to indicate True, False, False, True). Do not output anything else.

answer_format.notes: One correct consequence, one plausible-but-wrong distractor, one unrelated distractor, and one 'nothing extraordinary happens' option. Target ~30% of generated instances where the correct answer IS 'nothing extraordinary happens'.

template: Had {event} occurred at time {t2}ms, select all statements that would apply under this counterfactual scenario. Answer only with a 4 letter string using F and T to indicate your answers (ie. TFFT to indicate True, False, False, True). Do not output anything else.

answer_format.notes: Always include both fixed statements (one or both may be correct depending on the scenario). Add 2 random additional statements with a 50/50 correct/incorrect split. For self-correcting scenarios (~50% of instances), the escalation statement is incorrect and vice versa. Both statements may be simultaneously false (ambiguous scenario) or simultaneously true (bifurcation scenario) in rare cases.

template: Had {event} occurred at time {t2}ms, what would be the expected value of {signal} at T+{n}ms in this counterfactual case? Answer only with an integer or decimal number, nothing else.

answer_format.notes: Single float value with unit. Accept answers within a tolerance band.

template: Had {event} occurred at time {t2}ms, what would be the expected values of {joint_signal} at T+{n}ms in this counterfactual case? Answer only with a tensor of length 6 where each value is either integer or decimal. The values should be separated by the '_' character (ie. 10.2_9_2.1_1_7_0.21). Do not return anything else.

answer_format.notes: A 6-element vector of floats, one per joint axis (0-indexed). Format as a JSON array.
